description: Alpha-weighted beta-balanced binary cross entropy over class-position elements minus the sum of add-one-smoothed soft Dice scores per class, computed per volume from independent sigmoid probabilities and dense binary targets (paper Sec. II, Eq. (3)).

examples.title: Train a segmentation model with Combo Loss

name: Combo Loss for segmentation

parameters.alpha: finite weight in [0, 1] for the beta-weighted binary cross entropy (default 0.5)
parameters.beta: finite positive-label weight in [0, 1]; values below 0.5 penalize false positives more (default 0.5)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because dense binary targets do not support ignored labels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating sigmoid probabilities in [0, 1] shaped [B, C, *spatial], with independent class channels
parameters.reduction: none returns one loss per volume; mean or sum reduces the batch (default mean)
parameters.targets: dense binary one-hot or multi-label targets matching [B, C, *spatial]
